name: Recycling
highLevelGoals: The user aims to efficiently locate recycling facilities in their vicinity by searching with their zip code.
The user seeks to view essential details about recycling facilities, such as operational hours and accepted materials.
The user desires to see recycling facilities, public bins, and special waste drop-off sites displayed on an interactive map for easy navigation.
The user wants to be informed about upcoming recycling events and safe disposal opportunities.
The user aims to personalize their experience by saving favorite facilities and receiving tailored recommendations based on their schedule and waste types.
The user expects to have a channel to submit feedback, report issues, and ask questions to administrators.
The administrator aims to ensure that all recycling facility information displayed on the platform is current, accurate, and comprehensive.
The administrator seeks to review and act upon user feedback and complaints to continuously improve the service.
The administrator is responsible for implementing and maintaining robust security measures to protect all user and facility data.
The administrator aims to establish and maintain effective communication channels with recycling facility representatives.
The facility representative aims to independently update their facility's operational hours, accepted materials, and other relevant details.
The facility representative seeks a direct channel to communicate any concerns or issues regarding their facility's listing or the platform to the site administrators.
lowLevelGoals: The system should enable users to enter a zip code to initiate a search for recycling facilities within that area.
The system should provide options for users to refine their search results based on different categories of recycling facilities.
The system should display a list of recycling facilities that correspond to the user's zip code and any applied filters.
The system should allow users to click on a facility from the search results to view its specific details.
The system should display the opening and closing times for a chosen recycling facility.
The system should present a clear list of materials that a particular recycling facility accepts.
The system should provide the physical address and any available contact details (e.g., phone number, website) for a chosen facility.
The system should display all relevant recycling locations on a map interface.
The system should provide standard map navigation controls for users to move around and adjust the zoom level.
The system should display a small pop-up or tooltip with basic facility details when a user interacts with a map marker.
The system should send alerts to users regarding scheduled recycling events.
The system should inform users about opportunities for safely disposing of specific waste types.
The system should provide options for users to customize the types of event notifications they receive.
The system should allow users to mark specific facilities for quick access in the future.
The system should enable users to specify the types of materials they typically recycle to receive relevant suggestions.
The system should suggest facilities that align with the user's saved favorites, schedule, and waste types.
The system should provide a form or interface for users to submit comments, suggestions, or general feedback.
The system should provide a mechanism for users to describe and submit reports about technical problems.
The system should provide a channel (e.g., a contact form, a messaging system) for users to submit inquiries to administrators.
The system should provide an interface for administrators to input details for new recycling facilities.
The system should provide an interface for administrators to modify details of already listed recycling facilities.
The system should provide a function for administrators to delete facility entries from the database.
The system should provide an interface for administrators to view all feedback submitted by users.
The system should provide a mechanism for administrators to reply to user submissions, either directly or by marking them as resolved.
The system should provide tools for administrators to organize feedback (e.g., by severity, type) to facilitate action.
The system should ensure that all sensitive data is encrypted both in transit and at rest.
The system should provide tools for administrators to define and manage permissions for various user types (e.g., users, facility representatives, other administrators).
The system should provide access to logs that record system activities and potential security incidents.
The system should provide a communication tool for administrators to contact facility representatives.
The system should provide an interface for administrators to add, update, or remove contact details for facility representatives.
The system should provide a secure login mechanism for facility representatives to manage their specific facility data.
The system should provide an interface for facility representatives to modify the opening and closing times of their facility.
The system should provide an interface for facility representatives to add, remove, or modify the materials their facility accepts.
The system should provide an interface for facility representatives to modify additional information pertinent to their facility.
The system should provide a dedicated channel (e.g., a support ticket system, a contact form) for facility representatives to report problems.
The system should provide a channel for facility representatives to report bugs or suggest improvements related to the application's functionality.
